tasks.label: Run Docker
tasks.command: docker network inspect dragonblight-network >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create dragonblight-network; docker rm -f dragonblight_backend_container dragonblight_redis_container || true; docker run -d --name dragonblight_redis_container --network dragonblight-network -p 6379:6379 redis:7-alpine; until docker exec dragonblight_redis_container redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG; do echo 'Waiting for Redis...'; sleep 2; done; docker run -d --name dragonblight_backend_container --network dragonblight-network -p 8080:8080 -p 7054:7054 --env ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development --env DOTNET_USE_POLLING_FILE_WATCHER=1 --env Redis__ConnectionString=redis:6379 dragonblight_backend
